fullContent:
Yakrit Pilhari Loha 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Yakrit Pleeha Rogadhikara – 980 -992 
 Introduction 
 Yakrit Pilhari Loha is classical formulation that keeps the Vata, Pitta and Kapha balanced. This Ayurvedic medicine is in tablet form having heavy metal ingredients. It is efficient therapy to treat liver and spleen disorders. 
 Ingredients and Method of Preparation 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Shuddha Parada (Herbal purified Mercury) 
 Shuddha Gandhaka (Herbal purified Sulphur) 
 Loha Bhasma (Bhasma prepared from Iron) 
 Abhraka Bhasma (Purified and processed Mica) 
 Tamra Bhasma (Bhasma prepared from Copper) 
 20 g fine powder of each of:- 
 Manashila (Purified and processed Realgar) (Arsenic disulphide) 
 Haridra (Turmeric) ( Curcuma longa ) – rhizome 
 Shuddha Jayapala ( Croton tiglium) 
 Tankana Bhasma (Borax) 
 Shilajatu (Asphaltum) 
 Quantity sufficient of Juice extract of following for grinding for two times. 
 Danti ( Baliospermum montanum ) 
 Trivrit ( Operculina turpethum ) 
 Chitraka (Lead Wort) ( Plumbago zeylanica ) –root 
 Nirgundi ( Vitex negundo ) 
 Trikatu (Pepper, long pepper, ginger) 
 Ardraka (Ginger Rhizome) ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Bhringaraja ( Eclipta alba ) 
 
 Dosage 
 Consume 125-250 mg in the morning and evening, before or after having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Yakrit Pilhari Loha is an efficient Ayurvedic therapy for almost all types of ascites, fever, and edema. 
 It is also beneficial in conditions like jaundice, bloating, anemia, anorexia, indigestion. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine must be consumed under strict directions only. 
 Its self-medication might be unsafe. 
 It is better to avoid in children and pregnant ladies. 
 It’s over dose might result in side effects. 
 Have this medicine under recommended dose and specified period of time. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
